```sql
SELECT player_id, player_name,
       SUM(ast) AS total_ast,
       SUM(turnover) AS total_to,
       SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(turnover) AS ast_to_turnover_ratio
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
  AND played = 1
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) >= 20 AND SUM(turnover) > 0
ORDER BY ast_to_turnover_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
